replies.author: @trevorroberts-o7q
replies.text: the so called UK tried to get us to use the Metric system around 1970 when they Decimalised our currency. Actually they centennialised it. I was teaching @ the time  and remember the junior/primary schools being given the princely sum of around £50 per class to buy things like adhesive tape with millimeter/centimetre markings to "convert" Imperial rulers -(no not the Queen)to metric. Also they got rid of Cuisinere Rods - which were actually Metric and a successful addition to the teaching of Maths . We also bought coloured 1cm cubes !  All this resulted in a lot of confusion and this spread -not via schools- to the building trade where you had to order 2"x4" timber in metric lengths ! Oh the joy of brainy politicians !
